text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At last, the Japan Cup is here. We<n>arrive at the
track in the morning,<n>focused and ready.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ah... Grass Wonder and her trainer!<n>Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good morning. Have you come to<n>watch my
race once again?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I wouldn't dream of<n>missing the Beast's
Successor!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That reminds me! Have you two<n>seen the article
everyone's been<n>talking about online?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Which one, if I may ask?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a few quick taps, the reporter<n>holds up a
screen to show a news<n>site known for its Arima
Kinen<n>predictions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone knows the Arima Kinen is<n>one of the
biggest races—only the<n>best classic and senior year
Umamusume are voted in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at their predictions on<n>who will run this
year!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Both Maruzen and myself are on this<n>list.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has spent her classic<n>year building
up experience<n>specifically to challenge
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: This might be Grass's big chance to<n>race her!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and I, on the same trackat the Arima Kinen... Hehe, that wouldbe an honor.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's because of Maruzensky<n>that you've
been gathering so much<n>attention! Personally, I
can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm excited to see how<n>you do today, as
well! Do your best<n>out there!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...It's almost time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's be on our way.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If it isn't El. Did you come here to get<n>me?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí, sí! I've come to be your guide!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've got a race to win here, and it'sgonna be flashy! Grrrass Wonder,enter the riiiiing!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the ring? Are you sure we're<n>going to the
same place?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm headed to the track, to take the<n>title of "Beast's
Successor"...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And leave it in the dust.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Leave it, eh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you say! Now c'mon,<n>Grass! To the
paddock!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Trainer, I should be off.
